# TildaZ v0.9.0

**Your config is TOML now, and shortcuts work on any keyboard layout.**

- The config file is TOML instead of JSON, and every keyboard shortcut lives in it under
  `[keys]` — until now they were fixed in the binary.
  ([#493](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/493))
- Shortcuts and the global hotkey can be written by physical key position
  (`ctrl+[Backquote]`) instead of by the character a key types, so they land on the same
  spot on AZERTY, QWERTZ or Dvorak; on non-Latin layouts such as Russian, letter
  shortcuts keep working instead of going dead.
  ([#496](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/496))
- Clicks, drags and the wheel now reach programs that ask for them, so the mouse works
  inside vim, tmux, htop and anything else using mouse tracking.
  ([#502](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/502))

## Upgrade notes

- **Your settings do not carry over.** TildaZ no longer reads `config_N.json`; it writes
  a fresh `config_N.toml` with defaults on first run. The old JSON file is left untouched
  next to it, so copy your values across by hand. `CONFIG.md` lists every field.
  ([#493](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/493))
- **Ten instances, numbered 0 to 9** — one for each global hotkey from `F1` to `F10`. A
  config numbered 10 or higher is no longer recognised, so rename it to a free number
  below 10 if you still want that instance.
  ([#510](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/510))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.9.0-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.9.0-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.9.0-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.9.0-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.9.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.9.0-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.9.0-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.9.0-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
